definition_uz: O'rganish jarayonida o'qituvchi yoki tizim tomonidan beriladigan, talaba mustaqillikka erishgani sari asta-sekin olib tashlanadigan ko'mak (namuna, lug'at, tuzilma). Vygotskiyning Yaqin rivojlanish zonasi (ZPD) tushunchasiga asoslanadi.
definition_en: Temporary support given by a teacher or system that is gradually withdrawn as the learner becomes independent (Bruner, based on Vygotsky's ZPD).

definition_uz: Talaba mustaqil bajara oladigan va faqat ko'mak bilan bajara oladigan vazifalar orasidagi oraliq (Vygotskiy, 1978). TILORA ko'mak darajasini shu zonaga moslaydi.
definition_en: The gap between what a learner can do alone and what they can do with guidance (Vygotsky, 1978).

definition_uz: O'z bilish jarayonlarini rejalashtirish, kuzatish va baholash qobiliyati (Flavell, 1979). 4-qoida — talaba xulosani o'zi chiqaradi — shunga tayanadi.
definition_en: Awareness and regulation of one's own thinking: planning, monitoring and evaluating learning (Flavell, 1979).

definition_uz: Talabaning maqsad qo'yish, strategiya tanlash, o'zini kuzatish va natijaga qarab o'zini sozlash sikli (Zimmerman, 2002).
definition_en: A cyclical process of goal-setting, strategy use, self-monitoring and self-reflection (Zimmerman, 2002).

definition_uz: O'quv jarayoni davomida talabaning keyingi qadamini yo'naltirish uchun o'tkaziladigan baholash (Black & Wiliam, 1998). Yakuniy baho qo'yish maqsadida emas.
definition_en: Assessment used during learning to inform the next steps for learner and teacher (Black & Wiliam, 1998).

definition_uz: O'quv davri oxirida o'zlashtirish darajasini qayd etish uchun o'tkaziladigan baholash (imtihon, test).
definition_en: Assessment at the end of a period of learning to certify achievement (exams, final tests).

definition_uz: O'qitish boshlanishidan oldin talabaning kuchli va zaif tomonlarini aniqlovchi baholash. TILORA kirish diagnostikasi CEFR profilini shunday shakllantiradi.
definition_en: Assessment carried out before instruction to identify strengths and weaknesses and plan teaching.

definition_uz: Har bir mezon (mazmun, grammatika, leksika, izchillik) uchun daraja tavsiflari berilgan baholash jadvali. Analitik rubrika har mezonni alohida, holistik rubrika umumiy baholaydi.
definition_en: A scoring guide listing criteria and level descriptors; analytic rubrics score each criterion separately, holistic ones give one overall score.

definition_uz: Baholashda asos qilib olinadigan talab. 'Criteria' — ko'plik, 'criterion' — birlik; 'criterias' shakli xato.
definition_en: A standard by which something is judged. 'Criteria' is plural; 'criterion' singular.

definition_uz: Test aynan o'lchamoqchi bo'lgan narsani o'lchayotganlik darajasi (masalan, og'zaki nutq testi talaffuzni emas, grammatik bilimni o'lchasa, validligi past).
definition_en: The degree to which a test measures what it claims to measure.

definition_uz: Bir xil sharoitda qayta o'tkazilganda test bir xil natija berish darajasi; baholovchilar o'rtasidagi moslik (inter-rater reliability) ham shunga kiradi.
definition_en: Consistency of test results across occasions, forms and raters.

definition_uz: Yuqori ahamiyatli testlarning o'qituvchi nima o'qitishi va talaba qanday o'rganishiga ta'siri; ijobiy yoki salbiy bo'lishi mumkin.
definition_en: The influence of (high-stakes) testing on teaching and learning, positive or negative.

definition_uz: Samarali izoh uch savolga javob beradi: Qayerga ketyapman? Qanday ketyapman? Keyin qayerga? To'rt daraja: vazifa, jarayon, o'z-o'zini boshqarish, shaxs (Hattie & Timperley, 2007). TILORA izohlari 'task' va 'process' darajasida beriladi.
definition_en: Effective feedback answers Where am I going? How am I going? Where to next? at four levels: task, process, self-regulation, self (Hattie & Timperley, 2007).

definition_uz: Talabaning xatosiga o'qituvchi munosabati: to'g'ridan-to'g'ri (explicit) yoki bilvosita (recast, elicitation, metalingvistik ishora).
definition_en: Teacher responses to learner errors, explicit or implicit (recast, elicitation, metalinguistic clue).

definition_uz: Talaba xato gapini suhbatni uzmasdan to'g'ri shaklda takrorlash: 'Yesterday I go...' — 'Oh, you went to the library?'
definition_en: Implicitly reformulating a learner's erroneous utterance correctly without interrupting communication.

definition_uz: Ona tili (o'zbek/qoraqalpoq) qoidalarining ingliz tiliga xato ko'chirilishi: 'discuss about', 'I am agree', 'explain me', artikllarning tushib qolishi va h.k.
definition_en: Errors caused by transferring first-language patterns into the second language.

definition_uz: Talabaning ona tili va o'rganilayotgan til o'rtasidagi, doimiy rivojlanib boruvchi shaxsiy til tizimi (Selinker, 1972). Xatolar shu tizimning tabiiy bosqichi.
definition_en: The evolving linguistic system a learner builds between L1 and the target language (Selinker, 1972).

definition_uz: Tuzatilmagan xatoning talaba nutqida doimiy bo'lib qolishi. Sababli izoh (2-qoida) shuni oldini olishga qaratilgan.
definition_en: The permanent retention of incorrect forms in a learner's interlanguage.

definition_uz: Yevropa Kengashining til bilish darajalarini A1–C2 shkalasida 'can-do' tavsiflari bilan belgilovchi hujjati (2001; Companion Volume 2020). TILORA har ko'nikmani alohida CEFR darajasida o'lchaydi.
definition_en: Common European Framework of Reference for Languages: six levels A1–C2 described through 'can-do' statements (Council of Europe, 2001/2020).

definition_uz: CEFR dagi daraja tavsifi: 'B1: tanish mavzularda oddiy bog'langan matn yoza oladi'.
definition_en: A CEFR descriptor phrased as an ability, e.g. 'Can write simple connected text on familiar topics' (B1).

definition_uz: Muayyan kasb yoki soha ehtiyojiga moslashtirilgan ingliz tili o'qitish. TILORA da kasbiy yo'nalish — bo'lajak ingliz tili o'qituvchisining pedagogik diskursi.
definition_en: English teaching tailored to the needs of a specific profession or discipline.

definition_uz: Tilni grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri va vaziyatga mos ishlata olish qobiliyati (Hymes, 1972; Canale & Swain, 1980): grammatik, sotsiolingvistik, diskurs va strategik komponentlar.
definition_en: The ability to use language accurately and appropriately: grammatical, sociolinguistic, discourse and strategic competence (Hymes; Canale & Swain).

definition_uz: Tilni real muloqot vazifalari orqali o'rgatish yondashuvi; aniqlikdan ko'ra ma'no almashinuvi ustuvor.
definition_en: An approach that prioritises meaningful interaction and real communication tasks.

definition_uz: Dars real hayotiy vazifa (masalan, dars rejasi tuzish) atrofida quriladi: pre-task → task → language focus (Willis, 1996; Ellis, 2003).
definition_en: Lessons organised around meaningful real-world tasks: pre-task, task cycle, language focus.

definition_uz: An'anaviy dars tuzilmasi: yangi til taqdim etiladi, nazorat ostida mashq qilinadi, so'ng erkin qo'llanadi. TILORA 5 bosqichi shuni metakognitiv bosqichlar bilan kengaytiradi.
definition_en: A classic lesson shape: present new language, controlled practice, freer production.

definition_uz: Mazmun, jarayon, mahsulot va muhitni talabaning tayyorgarligi, qiziqishi va profiliga moslashtirish (Tomlinson, 2001). TILORA uch o'lchovli profil asosida tabaqalashtiradi.
definition_en: Adapting content, process, product and environment to learners' readiness, interests and profiles (Tomlinson, 2001).

definition_uz: Talabaning natijalariga qarab materialning qiyinligi, tartibi va ko'mak darajasini avtomatik sozlovchi tizim. TILORA da har bir o'zgarish o'qituvchi tasdig'idan o'tadi (3-qoida).
definition_en: Technology that adjusts difficulty, sequence and support based on learner performance.

definition_uz: Talaba uchun tuzilgan 16 haftalik mavzular, ko'nikmalar va ko'mak darajalari ketma-ketligi; har bir element 'rationale' (sabab) bilan birga keladi.
definition_en: A personalised sequence of topics, skills and support levels, each with a stated rationale.

definition_uz: Tizim qaroriga (nega aynan shu mavzu, shu ko'mak darajasi) deterministik shablondan tuzilgan ochiq izoh. Qora quti (black box) tavsiyalarga qarshi shaffoflik tamoyili.
definition_en: An explicit, template-generated explanation for every system decision (transparency against black-box recommendations).

definition_uz: Mashg'ulotning mustaqil bajarish bosqichida generatsiya, tarjima, davom ettirish va tayyor javob vositalarining server tomonidan o'chirilishi (403 AI_LOCKED). Kognitiv passivlikning (cognitive offloading) oldini oladi.
definition_en: Server-side disabling of generative AI tools during the independent production stage to prevent cognitive offloading.

definition_uz: Fikrlash jarayonini tashqi vosita (AI, kalkulyator)ga topshirish; til o'rganishda mustaqil nutq ko'nikmasi shakllanmasligiga olib keladi (Risko & Gilbert, 2016).
definition_en: Delegating cognitive work to external tools, which in language learning can hinder skill formation (Risko & Gilbert, 2016).

definition_uz: Ish xotirasiga tushadigan aqliy yuk (Sweller, 1988): ichki (materialning murakkabligi), tashqi (noqulay taqdimot) va samarali (sxema qurish). TILORA 'material hajmi sig'imi' ko'rsatkichi shunga tayanadi.
definition_en: The demand placed on working memory: intrinsic, extraneous and germane load (Sweller, 1988).

definition_uz: Horwitz, Horwitz & Cope (1986) tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan 33 bandli Likert anketasi: muloqot tashvishi, test tashvishi va salbiy baholanish qo'rquvi. TILORA qisqartirilgan moslashtirilgan variantini qo'llaydi.
definition_en: A 33-item Likert scale measuring communication apprehension, test anxiety and fear of negative evaluation (Horwitz et al., 1986).

definition_uz: Tashvish, past motivatsiya va ishonchsizlik til o'zlashtirilishiga to'siq bo'lishi (Krashen, 1982). Tashvish > 65 bo'lganda og'zaki nutq 1-haftadan surilishi shu gipotezaga asoslanadi.
definition_en: Krashen's hypothesis that anxiety, low motivation and low confidence block language acquisition.

definition_uz: O'z o'rganishi uchun mas'uliyatni o'z zimmasiga olish qobiliyati (Holec, 1981). Ko'mak darajasi 'none' (avtonom rejim) shu ko'rsatkich yuqori bo'lganda beriladi.
definition_en: The capacity to take charge of one's own learning (Holec, 1981).

definition_uz: Faoliyatning o'zi qiziq bo'lgani uchun (ichki) yoki baho/mukofot uchun (tashqi) o'rganish (Deci & Ryan, SDT).
definition_en: Learning for its own sake versus for external rewards (Self-Determination Theory).

definition_uz: O'qituvchi va o'quvchi o'rtasidagi ijobiy, ishonchli aloqa; xavfsiz xato qilish muhitining asosi.
definition_en: A positive, trusting relationship between teacher and learners.

term: Teacher Talk Time (TTT) / Student Talk Time (STT)
definition_uz: Darsda o'qituvchi va talabalar gapirgan vaqt nisbati; kommunikativ darsda STT ustun bo'lishi kutiladi.
definition_en: The proportion of lesson time taken by teacher versus student speech; CLT favours high STT.

definition_uz: Instruction Checking Questions — topshiriq tushunilganini tekshiradi ('Juftlikdami yoki yakkami?'); Concept Checking Questions — til ma'nosi tushunilganini tekshiradi.
definition_en: Instruction Checking Questions verify task understanding; Concept Checking Questions verify meaning of target language.

definition_uz: Tayyor javob berish o'rniga savol, ishora yoki misol orqali talabaning o'zidan javob olish texnikasi.
definition_en: Drawing answers out of learners with questions and prompts instead of telling them.

definition_uz: Bo'lajak o'qituvchining tengdoshlari oldida 10–15 daqiqalik qisqa dars o'tkazishi va so'ng tahlil qilinishi (Allen & Ryan, 1969).
definition_en: A short practice lesson (10–15 min) taught to peers and then analysed.

definition_uz: Dars maqsadi (SWBAT), bosqichlari, vaqt taqsimoti, materiallar, interaksiya shakllari va baholash usullari yozilgan hujjat.
definition_en: A written outline of objectives, stages, timing, materials, interaction patterns and assessment for a lesson.

definition_uz: O'qituvchining o'z darsini tizimli tahlil qilib, keyingi harakatini rejalashtirishi (Schön, 1983; Gibbs sikli). 5-bosqich refleksiya shunga asoslanadi.
definition_en: Systematically analysing one's own teaching to improve it (Schön, 1983; Gibbs' reflective cycle).

definition_uz: Talabalarning bir-birining ishini rubrika asosida baholashi; tanqidiy o'qish va avtonomiyani rivojlantiradi.
definition_en: Learners evaluating each other's work against criteria.

definition_uz: Akademik yozuvda da'voni yumshatuvchi vositalar: 'appears to', 'may', 'suggests', 'to some extent'.
definition_en: Language that softens academic claims: 'appears to', 'may', 'suggests'.

definition_uz: Cohesion — gaplarni bog'lovchi grammatik-leksik vositalar (however, therefore, olmoshlar); coherence — matnning mantiqiy yaxlitligi.
definition_en: Cohesion: grammatical/lexical links between sentences; coherence: overall logical unity of a text.

definition_uz: Matndagi takrorlanmas so'zlar sonining umumiy so'zlar soniga nisbati; TILORA leksika balini hisoblashda qo'llaydi.
definition_en: The ratio of unique words to total words, a measure of lexical diversity.

definition_uz: Tabiiy birga keladigan so'zlar: 'make a mistake' (×'do a mistake'), 'take a photo', 'do homework'.
definition_en: Words that naturally occur together: 'make a mistake', 'take a photo'.

definition_uz: Ma'ruza yoki inshoda tinglovchini yo'naltiruvchi iboralar: 'Firstly', 'Moving on to', 'To sum up'.
definition_en: Phrases that guide the listener/reader through a text: 'Firstly', 'To sum up'.

definition_uz: Pedagogik eksperimentda yangi metodika qo'llanadigan (tajriba) va an'anaviy usulda o'qitiladigan (nazorat) guruhlar; boshlang'ich tenglik χ² mezoni bilan tekshiriladi.
definition_en: In an educational experiment, the group receiving the intervention versus the group taught conventionally.

definition_uz: Ikki guruh o'rtacha natijalari farqining standart og'ishga nisbati: 0.2 — kichik, 0.5 — o'rta, 0.8+ — katta effekt.
definition_en: Standardised mean difference between two groups: 0.2 small, 0.5 medium, 0.8 large.

definition_uz: To'g'ri bajarilgan amallar sonining umumiy amallar soniga nisbati; K ≥ 0.7 bo'lganda ko'nikma o'zlashtirilgan hisoblanadi (Bespalko, 1989).
definition_en: Ratio of correctly performed operations to the total; mastery is assumed at K ≥ 0.7 (Bespalko, 1989).
